theme_and_concept.concept: Spider-Man: Brand New Day-inspired interactive computer desktop OS
theme_and_concept.vibe: Tech-noir, cinematic, dark, mysterious, retro-premium pixel art

fonts.name: Press Start 2P
fonts.usage: Headings, menu labels, buttons, terminal text, app titles, desktop icons

fonts.name: IBM Plex Mono
fonts.usage: Long descriptions, readable body text, complex code snippets

rules: Use strict tracking (letter-spacing) for 'Press Start 2P' to prevent layout breaking.
Never center align body text; maintain left-alignment for readable OS windows.
Use text shadows (red/blue subtle pixel drop shadows) to enhance the retro tech-noir feel.
No pure black #000000 except for the terminal background.
Window backgrounds MUST have backdrop-blur to simulate advanced translucent tech-noir glass.
Use Spider-Man red heavily for active states, hover glows, and the Spider-Sense indicator.

surfaces: Dark Translucent Windows: Use backdrop-blur-md with a 1px border of rgba(255,255,255,0.1) and a subtle red/blue pixelated drop shadow.

Pixel Borders: Avoid smooth border-radius where possible. Use hard 0px radius or precise pixel-step borders using box-shadow techniques to mimic retro OS if desired, but 0px radius with 1px sharp borders works well for a modern-retro hybrid.
effects: Spider-Sense Pulse: A red radial glow that expands and contracts behind interactive elements on hover.
Rain System: A subtle falling rain canvas or CSS animation in the background of the desktop and rooftop mode.
Web Strands: Subtle SVG lines connecting social nodes in the Social Connections app.
visual_enhancers.cursor: Custom CSS cursor using a pixel art spider or crosshair. Disable on mobile.
visual_enhancers.parallax: Subtle mouse-move parallax for the background image and sticky notes.

layouts_and_grids.desktop: 100vh, 100vw, overflow-hidden. A true OS environment. Elements are absolutely positioned or managed via a draggable window system.
layouts_and_grids.dock: Flexbox, bottom-center, floating. Icons scale up on hover (macOS style).
layouts_and_grids.menu_bar: Flexbox, top, w-full, h-8, fixed. Left and right justified content.
layouts_and_grids.mobile: Mobile phone OS (Spidey-Phone). Full-screen apps only. No window dragging. Vertical stack for desktop icons. Keep bottom dock.

motion_and_interactions.framer_motion: Mandatory for window dragging (drag, dragConstraints), minimizing (scale down to dock), maximizing, and opening from icons.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Pixel-perfect hover states. Icons should glow and show a 'web' effect underneath on hover.
motion_and_interactions.boot_sequence: Initial loader must show a black screen, spider-web loading animation, typing text 'BALA SYSTEM INITIALIZING...' before revealing the desktop.
motion_and_interactions.easter_eggs: Keyboard shortcut triggers 'SPIDER-SENSE' mode (screen darkens, red/blue flashes, web lines).

components_and_apps.window_manager: Custom React component managing an array of open apps, their z-index, and minimized states. Include title bar with red/yellow/green retro dots.
components_and_apps.desktop_icons: Double-click to open apps. Single-click to select (highlight state).
components_and_apps.terminal: Interactive. Commands: help, about, projects, skills, mission, github, linkedin, instagram, contact, clear, sudo hire-bala.
components_and_apps.suit_database: Grid of pixel art representations of skills (Backend Suit, AI Suit).
components_and_apps.spidey_phone_ticker: On mobile view, a scrolling marquee 'Live Build' ticker at the top or bottom for the Canva project.

backgrounds.usage: Main Desktop Background / Rooftop Mode background (NYC Night)
Terminal window backdrop or tech fallback image
Spider web subtle overlay or Boot Screen loading asset

media_and_images.icons: Use 'lucide-react' for UI vectors, but rely on custom CSS pixel styling or FontAwesome retro packs if necessary. Prefer building pixelated SVGs inline for absolute accuracy to the 'pixel art' constraint.

required: framer-motion (Window dragging, dock animations, boot screen)
lucide-react (Base icons, wrapped in pixelated filters)
react-draggable (Alternative to framer-motion for strict window management if preferred, but Framer Motion is requested)
react-fast-marquee (For the Live Build Spidey-Phone ticker)

accessibility_and_testing.prefers_reduced_motion: Respect by disabling rain, parallax, and intense flashes.
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: Every interactive desktop icon, menu item, dock item, window close button, and terminal input MUST have a data-testid.

instructions_to_main_agent: This is NOT a scrolling website. Do not build standard landing page sections.
Build a full-screen App container with overflow-hidden.
Implement a Window Context/State Provider to track opened windows, their coordinates, minimized status, and active z-index.
The Terminal is a core feature; build a robust command parser for the requested commands.
Ensure 'Press Start 2P' font is loaded correctly from Google Fonts.
Apply backdrop-filter for all opened windows to achieve the tech-noir glass look.
Mobile view should completely change the UX to 'Spidey-Phone' - apps open fullscreen, no dragging.
Add 'data-testid' to ALL critical interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on the provided image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
